title: Creamy Saag with {p}
steps: Soften a little garlic with the {spice} in oil for a minute, until fragrant.
Add the {v} and cook until tender and wilted, then blend or chop to a rough purée.
Stir in the {sauce} and the {p} and simmer gently until {doneness}.
tip: Coconut milk or a spoonful of yogurt stands in for cream, and the greens do most of the filling.
